advice_items.quote: most people can't say no to themselves... it drains you off all your resources your number one resource is your energy
advice_items.summary_en: Practice strict discipline, say no to indulgences, and protect your energy as your #1 resource.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持自律，守住精力不浪费

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: spending habits it's like people hate money right they got to get rid of it... got to keep up what the Jones is
advice_items.summary_en: Fix your spending habits instead of trying to get rid of money to keep up with the Joneses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 控制消费习惯，拒绝攀比消费

advice_items.quote: you don't chase money you become magnetized MoneyWise and money chases you
advice_items.summary_en: Tune into the consciousness of money so you become magnetized to wealth rather than desperately chasing it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 建立财富意识，吸引而非追逐金钱

guests.first_money_or_break: 原本是健身房私人教练，约17-18年前被他训练的一位客户发掘并推荐进入华尔街金融行业，曾多次破产，40多岁成为百万富翁。
guests.guest_name: Wall Street Finance Expert (Former Personal Trainer)
guests.wealth_detail: $80K best single month; millionaire in his 40s

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: it was an opportunity at the time to jump into a market that there was a lot of white space in so that's where I saw the opportunity and that's where I jumped in full force
advice_items.summary_en: Look for markets with lots of white space and jump in full force when you spot the opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 寻找市场空白机会并全力切入

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Set Exit Benchmarks (Long-Term Business, Disciplined Investing)
advice_items.quote: when it comes to business you want to think very longterm when it comes to Wall Street investing... set a benchmark and get out
advice_items.summary_en: Think long-term when building a business, but set return benchmarks and take profits when investing in financial markets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 实业看长期，金融投资设止盈目标

advice_items.quote: best financial decision that you made throughout your career I bet on myself
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself and take the risk to follow your own path if entrepreneurship is in your DNA.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于押注自己，承担创业风险

advice_items.quote: be okay with who you are naturally Don't Force being an entrepreneur or any other route
advice_items.summary_en: Accept who you are naturally and don't force entrepreneurship if you thrive better with corporate structure.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应天性，不适合创业就别强求

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身中产家庭，7岁卖糖果、14岁创办高压清洗公司；后在华尔街当经纪人月入仅2000美元勉强糊口一两年，最终辞职抓住巴西莓果昔连锁的市场空白，30岁成为百万富翁。
guests.wealth_detail: $20M+/yr business revenue; became a millionaire at 30
guests.zero_start_advice: 认清自己的天性与真正适合的路，如果天生适合创业就果断押注自己，如果更需要公司结构也不要强行创业。

advice_items.quote: Jay-Z said scared money don't make money
advice_items.summary_en: Scared money doesn't make money—you have to be willing to take risks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 胆小不生财，敢于冒险才能赚钱

advice_items.quote: you have to invest for the long term you know you have Warren Buffett talks about compounding
advice_items.summary_en: Invest for the long term and let compounding multiply every dollar over time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持长期投资，发挥复利效应

advice_items.quote: riches in niches right that's super important like you pick your Niche and you just go for it and then endurance for the win
advice_items.summary_en: Pick a niche and stick with it through setbacks—treat obstacles as speed bumps rather than brick walls.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕细分赛道，遇挫坚持不乱跳

advice_items.quote: they really understand the value of a dollar... and they value their time more than anything
advice_items.summary_en: Understand the value of a dollar—be frugal when it makes sense, spend without hesitation when it counts, and value your time above all.
advice_items.summary_zh: 懂得金钱价值，更要视时间如命

advice_items.quote: learn how to sell like sales is the greatest skill set of the new economy
advice_items.summary_en: Learn how to sell—sales is the greatest skill set of the new economy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会销售，它是新经济第一技能

advice_items.quote: work for yourself have 10 streams of income doing whatever you want whenever you want
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the outdated student-debt-to-9-to-5 script; work for yourself and build multiple streams of income.
advice_items.summary_zh: 为自己工作，打造多元收入来源

guests.first_money_or_break: 2006年到纽约做戏剧却花光积蓄，在雷曼兄弟破产当天考取房产经纪执照入行，最初只为每月赚2000美元付房租糊口，28岁左右成为百万富翁。
guests.wealth_detail: $22M single-year income (2021); ~$4.5B annual real estate sales; $195M single residential sale; became a millionaire at ~28
guests.zero_start_advice: 2024年想白手起家成为百万富翁，必须学会销售，不要被负债上大学和朝九晚五W2工作的传统剧本束缚，要为自己工作并打造多元收入流。

advice_items.quote: the only flaw you have is your inability to be canderous to people that you love in work and you're going to need to figure that out
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome the inability to be candid with people you care about at work, as avoiding tough honesty is a major weakness.
advice_items.summary_zh: 对共事的亲友保持坦诚直接

advice_items.quote: stop listening to [ __ ] other people people you put on a pedestal... you [ __ ] know your answer
advice_items.summary_en: Trust your gut and stop letting outside voices—even parents, teachers, or mentors—talk you out of what you know inside.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信直觉，别盲从外界和权威声音

advice_items.quote: I'm willing to eat [ __ ] in a way that you kids don't want to... entrepreneurship is... losing constantly with an occasional win
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to endure hardship and constant losses with patience—entrepreneurship is a fight, not a glamorous status game.
advice_items.summary_zh: 耐得住吃苦受挫，具备抗击打韧性

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Don't Care About Looking Successful vs. Being Successful
advice_items.quote: lack of patience entitlement at scale giving a [ __ ] about other people thinking you're successful versus being successful
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid impatience, entitlement, and caring about looking successful to others instead of actually being successful.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕虚荣心与急躁，重实绩而非面子

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Don't Put Being #1 on a Pedestal
advice_items.quote: everybody wants to be a number one but not everyone was built to be a number one... the number three at the biggest companies in the world will make more than 99.999999999% of number ones
advice_items.summary_en: Don't put being #1 on a pedestal—being #3 at a top company can beat 99.99% of founders if that fits who you are.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不必执着当一号位，找准自身定位

guests.zero_start_advice: 20岁从零开始时要相信自己的直觉、别盲从外部权威和亲友意见；同时不要盲目迷信当一号位创业，在顶级公司担任三号人物同样能创造巨额财富。
